info.name: Core accepted countries Journal Entries API

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to retrieve journal entries.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of journal entry resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Starting date of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Ending date of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: start_impact_time
params.description: Starting `impact_time` of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: end_impact_time
params.description: Ending `impact_time` of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: start_created_time
params.description: Starting `created_date` of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: end_created_time
params.description: Ending `created_date` of the date range from which to return journal entries.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Array of statuses by which to filter journal entries.

params.name: detail_token
params.description: Detail token of the journal entries to return.

params.name: groups
params.description:
Array of groups by which to filter journal entries.

To return all journal entry groups, do not include this query parameter.

params.name: expand
params.description: Embeds the specified object into the response.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `createdTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `created_time`.

params.name: card_tokens
params.description:
Array of card tokens by which to filter journal entries.
Returns journal entries associated with the specified card tokens.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/cards/` to retrieve existing card tokens.

params.name: user_tokens
params.description:
Array of user tokens by which to filter journal entries.
Returns journal entries associated with the specified user tokens.

Send a `GET` request to `/users` to retrieve existing user tokens.

params.name: types
params.description:
Array of <</core-api/event-types#_credit_journal_entry_events, event types>> by which to filter journal entries.

To return all event types, do not include this query parameter.

items.docs:
Retrieve an array of journal entries on a credit account.

This endpoint supports <</core-api/sorting-and-pagination, sorting and pagination>> and <</core-api/object-expansion, object expansion>>.

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to retrieve journal entries.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: journal_entry_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the journal entry you want to retrieve.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/journalentries` to retrieve existing journal entry tokens.

items.docs: Retrieve a journal entry for a credit account.

params.name: event_type
params.description: Specifies the type of event you want to resend.

params.name: resource_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the resource for which you want to resend a notification.

* Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/journalentries` to retrieve existing journal entry tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/ledgerentries` to retrieve existing ledger entry tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/accounts/{account_token}/accounttransitions` to retrieve existing account transition tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/payments/{payment_token}` to retrieve existing payment transition tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/accounts/{account_token}/statements` to retrieve existing statement summary tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/accounts/{account_token}/delinquencystate/transitions` to retrieve existing delinquency state transition tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/accounts/{account_token}/statements/{statement_summary_token}/paymentreminders/{token}` to retrieve existing payment reminder tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/credit/substatuses` to retrieve existing substatus tokens.
* Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens and identify the specific account for the resend event.

items.docs:
Resends a credit event notification to your webhook endpoint.

Although you send this request as a `POST`, all parameters are passed in the URL and the body is empty.
The event notification is resent to your webhook endpoint and also returned in the response to this request.

For details on how to configure your webhook endpoint, see the About Webhooks <</developer-guides/about-webhooks#_tutorial, tutorial>>.
For the complete `/webhooks` endpoint reference, see <</core-api/webhooks, Webhooks>>.
